Face Recognition for Intelligent Library Management

A library system where borrowing and returning books is automated with face recognition. Built with PHP, MySQL and AJAX.

  1. Set up the userLibrary or school ID, name and course are added first.
  2. Face the cameraThe system captures the face and verifies the user.
  3. BorrowOnce verified, state the books you want. No logbook needed.
  4. ReturnFace the camera again. The system records the books and the admin confirms.
